note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: Fig. 3 caption pressures (9.2 · 20.1 · 50.9 · 146.8 MPa) ≠ text pressures for the same 10–40 % stages (14.2 · 50.3 · 98.7 · 157.7 MPa; Fig. 4b agrees with the text); Fig. 4a experimental point at 80 MPa (≈28.6 %) ≠ Table 1 (27.75 %) and a 120 MPa point (≈27.8 %) has no Table 1 row; SI Table 3 bond E 10 GPa ≠ text 'same value as the particle' (NMC 5 GPa) and σ_B^t 0.038 ≠ σ_B^n 0.1 GPa although the text requires σ_B^cn = σ_B^ct; Fig. S3 'Sigma value' 0.1–1.0 ×10^6 has no unit and does not reach Table 3's 0.1 GPa; Eq. (6) printed as −|F_B^n|/A_b; text 'electrode of a thickness of 114 μm' ≠ Table 1 99.03 μm.
key_note: keys: f<N> = figure N · fS<N> = SI figure; f<N><panel> = panel (panel_of); t1 = Table 1 · tS1–tS3 = SI Tables 1–3; e<n> = Eq. (n), e1_3 / e4_7 = stacked equation sets with definitions; x<page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind 'text', multi-part ones list 'parts' [page, x0, y0, x1, y1]); v<video>_<t> = video frame (kind 'movie_frame'); ga = cover feature thumbnail.
